adminHelp: In OBS, add a browser source on the overlay address. To push an alert from another tool:
noToken: No sending code set: only the test alert works. To set one: “Settings” tab, “Sending code” option (advanced mode).
ytHelp: Super Chats, Super Stickers and memberships on your YouTube live appear here, one after the other. They come from the YouTube live actions module, which reads the chat **only while its “Live” page is open**: keep it open during the live. Message texts stay hidden unless you tick “Show the text of YouTube messages” in the settings.
ytTestError: The test alert could not be prepared.
ytAbsent: To also show Super Chats and memberships from your YouTube live, install the “YouTube live actions” module.
tw_f_min_gift: Smallest number of gifted subs shown
tw_f_min_help: Smaller ones are not shown. Empty or 0 shows everything.
tw_intro: Choose which Twitch events appear on screen, and how they read.
tw_linked: Twitch activity is linked: open its settings
tw_absent: To show your Twitch events, install the module Twitch activity.
tw_preset_ok: The {style} style is applied to every type.
tw_f_template_help: Plain words. Words between braces are replaced: {name} {count} {amount} {tier} {months} {viewers} {level} {title} {text} {total}. Empty restores the default sentence.
tw_f_seconds_help: Between 2 and 60 seconds. Empty uses the duration of the Settings tab.
tw_err_type: This type does not exist. Reload the page, for example with F5.
tw_err_template: Unknown word: {words}. Use only {vars}, for example {name} follows you.
tw_err_long: The text is too long. Write {n} characters at most, for example Thanks {name}.
tw_err_seconds: Write a whole number from {min} to {max}, for example 8.
tw_err_min: Write a whole number from 0 to {max}, for example 100.
q_running: Alerts are running. Waiting to be grouped: {n}.
q_paused: Alerts are paused. {n} held, they come out when you resume.
q_pause_ok: Paused: new alerts are held, nothing is lost.
tw_f_sound_help: Made by the page itself, nothing is loaded. Heard only if sounds are switched on.
tw_f_image_help: A picture of your site, shown above the text. PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF.
tw_err_choice: This choice does not exist. Pick one from the list, for example Chime.
tw_err_image: This picture could not be kept. Send it again, for example a PNG of 200 px.
tw_simulate_btn: Show a sample evening on screen
tw_simulate_ok: {n} sample alerts sent: they come one after the other, as on stream.
vw_intro: Choose what the text of viewers does on screen, and whether alerts are read aloud.
md_intro: Pictures, GIFs, videos and sounds that your bot commands can show on stream.
tw_f_video_help: Add videos in the Media tab.
tw_f_video_sound: Play the sound of the video
tw_f_tts_help: Needs the voice, switched on in the Viewer texts tab.
tw_f_viewer_help: Shown after the sentence, if the viewer wrote one.
tw_err_video: Pick a video that you added, for example Video 1.
tw_err_gif: Add a picture first, for example a GIF.
tw_err_viewer_max: Write a whole number between {min} and {max}, for example 140.
tts_f_voice_help: The voices come from your computer.
tts_f_lang_help: Empty: the language of the site.
tts_f_name: Read the name of the person
tts_test_message: This is a test of the voice.
tts_test_ok: Sample sent. Open the overlay in OBS to hear it.
tts_err_off: The voice is off. Switch on the voice and save, for example with Read alerts aloud.
tts_err_range: Write a number between {min} and {max}, for example 1.
tts_err_lang: Write two letters, for example en or fr.
tts_state_unknown: No overlay page has reported yet. Open the overlay in OBS once.
tts_state_nosupport: The overlay page cannot read aloud. OBS may be too old.
tts_state_novoice: The overlay page sees no voice. Install a voice on the computer that runs OBS.
tts_state_muted: The voice is on but muted from the dock.
tts_state_ok: The voice is ready: {n} voices seen by the overlay page.
mod_f_hold_help: Hide the text only, or hold the whole alert for you.
mod_f_words_example: For example: one word per line
mod_f_words_help: Empty by default. Case and accents do not matter.
mod_err_words: The list is too long. Keep 4000 characters at most.
mod_limits: This is a basic filter. It does not replace Twitch AutoMod.
mod_empty: No text is waiting. Refused texts will appear here.
mod_accepted: Accepted. The alert shows again with its text.
mod_err_unknown: This text is not waiting any more.
tw_f_audio_help: Plays instead of the chosen sound. Needs sounds switched on.
tw_err_audio: Send a sound of the site, for example an MP3 file.
md_delete_confirm: Delete this file? It is removed from your site, and the commands that use it show nothing.
md_empty: No file yet. Add a picture, a GIF or a sound.
md_err_name: Write a name of 40 characters at most. For example: Applause.
md_err_dup: This name is already used. Pick another, for example: Applause 2.
md_err_file: Send a file with the button, for example a PNG, GIF or MP3.
md_err_full: The library is full ({max} files). Delete some before adding more.
md_err_unknown: This file does not exist (any more).
md_err_busy: Too many files shown in a minute. Try again in a moment.
